translations.web: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh’s.
translations.bsb: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion to rule over the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD'S.
translations.asv: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be Jehovah's.
